preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The length of each string n must be between 1 and 100,000.
Strings A and B must have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: all('a' <= char <= 't' for char in A) and all('a' <= char <= 't' for char in B)
preconditions.description: Both strings A and B must consist of the first 20 lowercase English alphabet letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(-1) if any(A[i] != B[i] for i in range(n)) and not any(A.count(char) > 1 for char in set(A)) else stdout == str(sum(1 for i in range(n) if A[i] != B[i]))
postconditions.description: If it's impossible to make A equal to B, output -1. Otherwise, output the number of moves required to make A equal to B.
